label: Bible Study
prompt: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other _____, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
verse: And they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit gave them utterance.
note: Pentecost — the Spirit arrives and the disciples speak in languages they'd never learned.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath _____ thee; go in peace.
verse: And he said to the woman, Thy faith hath saved thee; go in peace.
note: A sinful woman washed Jesus's feet with her tears; He sent her off forgiven, saved, and in peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a _____, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
verse: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
note: Modern versions say rattling; the KJV says a noise and a shaking — and the dry bones came together, bone to his bone.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be _____ blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
verse: And the very God of peace sanctify you wholly; and I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless unto the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
note: Spirit, soul and body — Paul prays for the whole person to be kept blameless until Christ comes.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was _____ helped, till he was strong.
verse: And he made in Jerusalem engines, invented by cunning men, to be on the towers and upon the bulwarks, to shoot arrows and great stones withal. And his name spread far abroad; for he was marvellously helped, till he was strong.
note: King Uzziah was 'marvellously helped, till he was strong' — and the next verse says his heart was lifted up. Strength became his snare.
